title: Lift and transport cocones along coherent diagram and apex equivalences
statement: Use quasicategories, coherent functor simplicial sets, equivalence edges, constant diagrams and colimiting cocones of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], in a universe containing all the data. Let $K$ be any small simplicial set, $\mathcal C$ a quasicategory and $\mathscr D=\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal C)$. Let $d,d':K\to\mathcal C$, $p,p'\in\mathcal C$, and $\sigma:d\to\Delta_Kp$ be a cocone. For every equivalence edge $e:d\to d'$ of $\mathscr D$ and equivalence edge $a:p\to p'$ of $\mathcal C$, there exist a cocone $\sigma':d'\to\Delta_Kp'$ and an equivalence edge $H:\sigma\to\sigma'$ in $\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,\mathscr D)$ whose source-endpoint restriction is exactly $e$ and whose target-endpoint restriction is exactly $\Delta_Ka$. For every such $\sigma'$ and $H$, the cocone $\sigma$ is colimiting if and only if $\sigma'$ is colimiting. This invariance also holds for the images of such a square $H$ under any functor $G:\mathcal C\to\mathcal E$ to a quasicategory: the image of $\sigma$ is colimiting if and only if the image of $\sigma'$ is colimiting. No existence of other colimits and no colimit-preservation assumption on $G$ are imposed; the empty shape $K=\varnothing$ is included.
